description: Debian server fleet overview: SSL certificate expiry for the 8 application URLs, then server health, CPU, memory, disk, network and the Tahseel NAS. Cluster and server selectors filter the server panels.

panels.description: All 8 cluster application URLs, sorted by days left. Days left: red under 10 (alert fires), orange under 20, yellow under 30, green 30+. Renewal = OVERDUE when under 30 days: Let's Encrypt renews at 30 days left, so the automatic renewal has not run. Status = the TLS handshake and certificate verification (trusted chain, correct name, not expired). Seven URLs are checked by blackbox (prometheus/targets/ssl/urls.json); Tahseel is checked on uc01 by scripts/ssl_cert_metrics.sh.

targets.expr: max by (project, domain, instance) (probe_success{job="ssl_cert_url", reachable!~"no|pending"}) or max by (project, domain, instance) (probe_success{job="ssl_cert_url", reachable=~"no|pending"} * 0 - 1)
max by (project, domain, instance) ((probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job="ssl_cert_url"} - time()) / 86400 < bool 30)

panels.title: SSL Certificate Expiry by Application URL
Server Status
panels.description: UP = Prometheus can scrape node_exporter on the server; DOWN = the server, its node_exporter or the network path (VPN/tunnel) is down. Filter with the Cluster and Server selectors.

panels.title: System Uptime
panels.description: Time since each server last booted. A very short uptime means an unplanned reboot.

panels.title: RAM Usage
panels.description: Memory in use, excluding reclaimable cache. Yellow from 75%, red from 90%.

panels.title: Root Disk Usage
panels.description: Space used on the root (/) filesystem. Yellow from 75%, red from 85%: clean logs or Docker images before it fills.

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: CPU busy % averaged over 5 minutes (all cores). Yellow from 70%, red from 85%.

panels.title: CPU Utilization History
panels.description: CPU split by mode over time. High I/O wait means the CPU is waiting on disk, not busy computing.

panels.title: System Load Average
panels.description: Run-queue length over 1, 5 and 15 minutes. Sustained values above the core count mean the server is overloaded.

panels.title: Memory Distribution
panels.description: Memory split into used, cache, buffers and free (stacked). Cache is reclaimable, so watch Used, not Free.

panels.title: Disk I/O Throughput
panels.description: Bytes read and written per second per disk.

panels.title: Network Bandwidth Throughput
panels.description: Network traffic in and out per interface (loopback, docker and veth interfaces excluded).

panels.title: Packet Drops & Network Errors
panels.description: Dropped packets and interface errors per second. Anything above zero that persists points to a network or NIC problem.

panels.title: NAS Usage
panels.description: Tahseel NAS (/u2_nas, CIFS) space used. Yellow from 80%, red from 90%.

panels.title: NAS Free Space
panels.description: Free space left on the Tahseel NAS.

panels.title: NAS Mount Status
panels.description: MOUNTED when Tahseel's /u2_nas CIFS share is mounted; MISSING means recordings cannot be written to the NAS.

panels.title: NAS Alert Status
panels.description: Whether any NAS alert (NasUsageWarning, NasUsageCritical, NasMountMissing) is firing right now.

panels.title: NAS Capacity & Free Space Trend
panels.description: Tahseel NAS used and free space over the selected time range.
